reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: forceLogoutAll is exported and has non-test callers in SystemTab.tsx:34 and route.ts:28 — not dead code. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions map in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; the admin UI is an authenticated but internal actor, no trusted-source lookup resolves against this path. Gate 3: src/app/actions.ts is explicitly in-scope and 'Force-logout-all time gate bypass' is listed as a key security concern. Code confirmed: actions.ts:631-679 contains zero time gate checks — an admin can trigger forceLogoutAll() via SystemTab at any hour, bypassing the 22:50–23:50 JST restriction that only exists in route.ts:16-25. An attacker (admin) can trigger this via the admin panel System tab by clicking the force-logout button at any time of day (e.g., 09:00 JST), causing all currently clocked-in employees to be forcibly clocked out with falsified timestamps.
